title: UFO sightings in Varese

tellings.quote: because 1953 they say that in Varese in north of Italy was some apparitions of so-called UFOs.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on what a grandson of Marconi, the Italian radio pioneer, told him: in 1953 people around Varese, a town in northern Italy, reported seeing so-called UFOs, meaning unidentified flying objects. The story comes up as part of a wider conversation, and if true it would place these sightings in Italy as early as the 1950s.
